color.note: One dark theme by design: the office is a night scene. Neon hues mark meaning (room kind, bot state, selection); surfaces stay violet-black.

tokens.name: void
tokens.usage: Page ground and the text on any neon fill.

tokens.name: floor
tokens.usage: The scene floor and the base every room platform tints.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: HUD panels in the rail.

tokens.name: panel-raised
tokens.usage: Desk tops and a hovered row inside a panel.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, panel borders, the floor grid, empty progress.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of controls at rest.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Primary text.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, roles in a name tag.

tokens.name: magenta
tokens.usage: The brand neon: the Chief's hub, the selected bot, keyboard focus, the start of a hand-off beam, panel corner brackets. Never a state.

tokens.name: cyan
tokens.usage: Code rooms, links from the hub to a Lead, the end of a hand-off beam.

tokens.name: acid
tokens.usage: Research rooms.

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Chat rooms (no goal workflow).

tokens.name: run
tokens.usage: State: running a turn.

tokens.name: queue
tokens.usage: State: queued behind another job.

tokens.name: wait
tokens.usage: State: waiting for the person. Also the fill of every button that answers such a wait.

tokens.name: out
tokens.usage: State: out of AI usage; a Tester FAIL; a failed check.

tokens.name: idle
tokens.usage: State: idle.

tokens.name: on-neon
tokens.usage: Text and initials set on a neon fill.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Chakra Petch, loaded from Google Fonts with its Vietnamese subset. Uppercase only in title and label.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: The screen title, uppercase, once per screen.

styles.name: room
styles.usage: Room names on the HUD tag and in goal rows.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Panel headings and floor lettering, uppercase.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Reset lúc 14:00 · task đã giao lại cho Vega

styles.name: name-tag
styles.usage: A bot's name in the scene.

groups.name: Data
groups.note: Every number, path, command, model id and hash.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Counters, paths, commands, model ids; tabular figures.

styles.name: data-xs
styles.usage: State tags in the scene and tag chips, uppercase.

spacing.note: Values copied from the reference screen; 2px steps below 16.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Dot-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Between chips in a row.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between goal rows; inside small controls.

tokens.name: space-2.5
tokens.usage: Inside a goal row and between a panel heading and its body.

tokens.name: space-3.5
tokens.usage: Panel padding, the gap between stage and rail, between panels.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page side gutter (with the safe-area max).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Below the last section.

radius.note: Hard edges. Corners are cut (notch), not rounded; only status dots are round.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Panels, platforms, the progress bar.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Name tags, bubbles and tag chips.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons and filter chips.

tokens.name: radius-dot
tokens.usage: Status dots and bot cores only.

notch.note: Size of the cut corner (clip-path) on HUD shapes.

tokens.name: notch-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons and goal rows.

tokens.name: notch-md
tokens.usage: Panels and the stage.

opacity.note: The few translucencies the system allows.

tokens.name: opacity-scanline
tokens.usage: The scanline overlay over the whole page.

tokens.name: opacity-dim
tokens.usage: A room or beam filtered out of view.

tokens.name: opacity-grid
tokens.usage: The floor grid.

iso.note: The isometric projection every scene element shares.

tokens.name: iso-unit
tokens.usage: Screen length of one world unit; x' = (x - y) * unit * 0.866, y' = (x + y) * unit * 0.5 - z * unit.

tokens.name: iso-desk
tokens.usage: Desk box in world units: width, depth, height.

tokens.name: iso-platform
tokens.usage: Room platform thickness in world units.

shadow.note: Glow, not elevation: light comes from the neon itself.

tokens.name: glow-magenta
tokens.usage: The selected bot, the hub core, focused controls.

tokens.name: glow-cyan
tokens.usage: Active filter chip, code-room edges.

tokens.name: glow-wait
tokens.usage: Buttons that answer a wait.

tokens.name: panel-depth
tokens.usage: HUD panels and the stage against the void.
